name: Security Documentation (IRCC)
tagline: Drafts and checks security design document sections · runs in Microsoft Foundry
instructions: Drafts or reviews security design document sections from the architecture, designs and control mappings, citing a source for every paragraph. It also checks control coverage and flags where configuration evidence contradicts the documents.
starters: Draft the SDD from the attached architecture and TDD
Check the attached SDD against the architecture
Which controls aren't covered by the attached SDD?
attachHint: Attach the architecture and designs (.docx, .pdf or .md, with 'FDD' or 'TDD' in design file names); to review, attach the SDD with 'SDD' in its name; control mappings go in a .jsonl file.
